title: Promote generated algebra transforms into reusable definitions
summary: Turn generated algebra family metadata into reusable SemanticTransformation definitions for fraction split/merge, exponent lowering, radical rewrite, function wrapping, distribution/factoring, simplification, and cancellation.

sourceRefs.summary: Generated algebra family registry that currently names the source fixture families.
Generated fixtures that currently create family-specific semantic transformations and diagrams.
SemanticTransformation contract and correspondence validation target.
Existing KaTeX transform fixture taxonomy to retire as the sole definition source.
Generated algebra law checks to extend for promoted definitions.

expectedLearning: Which generated algebra families are ready to become reusable SemanticTransformation modules instead of fixture-local metadata.
What correspondence fields and law refs are needed for each family to preserve identity, structure, value, role, and presentation honestly.
Where fixtures should keep template convenience separate from semantic type explosion.
allowedWork: Extract or add reusable transform definition data for generated algebra families.
Keep generated fixture specs as templates and object inputs, not as the only source of semantic transformation meaning.
Add law checks that prove fixture-generated transformations reference existing objects and selectors.
disallowedWork: Do not redesign the whole semantic object registry in this slice.
Do not add a new animation effect unless it is represented through existing motif or frame contracts.
Do not broaden into graph, curriculum, media, or package loading implementation.
